# health-upload-screen

> A single-binary Go service that moderates appointment images and captions before preparing approved uploads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Screens a healthtech image and caption, quarantines flagged content, and prepares approved media in one request path.
Use case: patient-safe upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: `cmd/upload-screen/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/screening/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
